subject: Issue #20 — file-level PR ownership and compatibility

findings.statement: PR #2 adds portfolio/dispatcher.py and offline tests; it is not present on main.
PR #14 adds portfolio/idea_intake.py; PR #15 adds portfolio/v4/exporter.py plus cycle/artefact schemas. Distinct paths do not establish compatibility.
PR #42 is a proposed plan; PR #43 adds AGENTS.md/templates; PR #44 is stacked on #43 and thus cannot be treated as independently merged.
Changed-path overlap across nine draft PRs is zero based on current GitHub filename lists, but no complete source-level interface audit was performed.
Selected portfolio module files are absent from main, confirming draft code is not yet active default-branch implementation.

missingEvidence: Read actual full source interfaces and imports for PRs #2/#14/#15
Dependency graph and conflict/rebase assessment across draft branch heads
Evaluate migration path for existing registry ids; no database inspection was performed in this pilot
Exact-head CI runs for each referenced implementation PR and current default-branch integration tests
recommendations: Propose ownership: portfolio/dispatcher.py as offline planner, portfolio/idea_intake.py as intake, portfolio/v4 as schema/export; validate imports and contracts before adoption.
Review PR #42 and #43 before admitting v1.1 dependency; keep #44 stacked and draft until its base is approved.
Build an interface-level compatibility table for #2/#14/#15 with synthetic contract tests, then record an ADR that explicitly rejects parallel dispatcher implementations.
